what: MEASURED, 2026-10-02. The sign flip is NOT caused by the trail4 proposal: a control rebuild at the committed trail_mult 5.0 gives the identical net_r_oos 5.9389 (n=16), so it comes purely from the 3-day-newer 365d window dropping early winners. Consequence: the committed xrp_4h Stage-0 record that the operator was told had a POSITIVE p10 (SIGNAL-0005) is window-sensitive, n=16, and the next time anything refreshes it the Stage-2 pricing for this real-money bybit_2 leg reads negative. The builder is manual-only (no cadence), so nothing refreshes it silently today; the exposure is that any config edit to this leg forces a refresh (fingerprint guard) and that edit then fails the pin. NOT DONE HERE: the pin was not loosened (it is the operator's priced fact) and the record on main was not touched. HELD PR #15594 is therefore red on exactly this test and stays so until the manager decides. Options for the manager: (a) accept the refresh and restate the pricing; (b) close #15594 (its trail4 case is already fragile: 1 of 3 partitions); (c) leave the leg's config alone.
